name: 36-cu-sith
description: Cu Sith: the green fairy hound of the Scottish Highlands, big as a calf, a shaggy mossy green mane over its shoulders, pale green belly and legs, a long tail coiled up over its back, oversized paws, pointed ears. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Standing in place: it breathes, its mossy mane rising and settling, its coiled tail swishing, then it lifts its head and gives one silent bark. Feet planted, same facing, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
